## CROSS-DOMAIN COMMON HEADER/FOOTER PATTERN

### Header/Letterhead Block (typical):
```
[Kementerian Kesehatan Logo]
Labkesmas [City/Region] OR Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat (BBLKM) [City]
[Address, Phone, Website, QR code]
```

### Lab Department/Installation Line:
- "Pengujian Instalasi Laboratorium [Department Name]"
- Examples: "Laboratorium Kesehatan Lingkungan, Vektor dan Binatang Pembawa Penyakit"; "Laboratorium Patologi Klinik & Imunologi"

### Report Title & Number Block:
```
LAPORAN HASIL UJI / LAPORAN HASIL PEMERIKSAAN
Report of Analysis / Test Result Report (English parallel sometimes included)

No. [Report Code Format]
Examples:
  - No. 25034965 / LHU I BBLK-MKS / XI / 2025
  - LHU NO.201-220.EN.JKT/SN/2026
  - LHU No.143/K-AM/III/2026 (K = water, AM = air minum, III = month, 2026 = year)
  - RS.02.02/B.X.2/7424/R/2026 (R suffix = KAN-accredited)
```

### Customer/Submitter Block:
```
Yth. [Customer Name/Title]
[Full address — street, RT/RW, village, district, city]
OR
Nama Customer / Submitter
Alamat / Address
```

### Sample Receipt & Testing Timeline:
```
Tanggal Penerimaan (Received Date): [DD-MM-YYYY]
Tanggal Pengujian (Test Date): [DD-MM-YYYY to DD-MM-YYYY]
Tanggal Hasil/Results Date: [DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM]
```

### Core Sample Description Section:
**For ENVIRONMENTAL:**
```
No. Contoh Uji | Jenis Contoh Uji | Asal Contoh Uji | Pengambil Contoh Uji | Lokasi Pengambilan | Metode Sampling | Tanggal diambil/diterima | Uraian
```

**For VECTOR:**
```
Jenis Pemeriksaan | Asal Sampel | Lokasi Sampel | Tanggal Penerimaan/Pemeriksaan | Petugas
```

### Results Table Block:
```
[LAPORAN HASIL PENGUJIAN / HASIL PEMERIKSAAN]

Typical columns:
  - No. | Parameter | Hasil Uji/Analisis | Baku Mutu (threshold) | Satuan (Unit) | Metode (Method) | Keterangan (Notes)

Keterangan field often includes:
  - * = Parameter yang terakreditasi KAN (KAN-accredited)
  - – = Tidak diperiksa (Not tested)
  - # = Pemeriksaan telah melampaui holding time
```

### Validation/Verification Block:
```
Telah diverifikasi oleh (Verified by): [Name, Title, Credential]
Telah divalidasi oleh (Validated by): Kepala Instalasi [Department] — [Full Name], [Title]
NIP [Civil Service ID]: YYMMDDPPPPPGGPP format
```

### Signature Block:
```
[City], [Date in Full]

[Signature placeholder — often ${ttd} in templates]
[Printed Name]
[Title/Position]
[NIP/ID Number]

OR (for e-signature):
"Dokumen ini telah ditandatangani secara elektronik menggunakan sertifikat elektronik
yang diterbitkan oleh Balai Besar Sertifikasi Elektronik (BSrE), Badan Siber dan Sandi Negara (BSSN)."
```

### Page Numbering & Footer:
```
Halaman [X] dari [Y] (Page X of Y)
[Optional: QR code for online verification or satisfaction survey]
[Powered by TCPDF or similar for generated PDFs]
```

### Accreditation Logo/Marking:
- KAN (Komite Akreditasi Nasional) logo often appears on accredited reports
- Reports marked with or without "LOGO KAN" in filename/header
- Accreditation status per parameter indicated by asterisk (*) in Keterangan column
- Report code suffix "/R" signals KAN-accredited testing

### Standard Authority References:
- **SNI** — Standar Nasional Indonesia (Indonesian National Standard)
- **Permenkes** — Peraturan Menteri Kesehatan (Ministry of Health Regulation), e.g., Permenkes RI No. 02 Tahun 2023
- **Permen LHK** — Peraturan Menteri Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan (Ministry of Environment & Forestry), e.g., No. 68/2016
- **WHO** — World Health Organization standards (less common)
- **In House Methode** — Lab's own validated method

### Notable Variations Across Samples:
1. Some reports use **parallel English headers/titles** ("Report of Analysis"); others Indonesian-only
2. Some labs use **digital e-signatures** (BSSN certificates); others use template placeholders (${ttd}, ${nama_pengirim})
3. **Multi-report bundling:** Some submissions consolidate multiple LHU numbers under one cover letter
4. **Accreditation indicator:** Presence of "/R" in report code or "Akreditasi" in filename signals KAN-accreditation
5. **Template vs. Filled Form:** FRM.LHU.03, FRM.LHU.01 are blank templates; filled versions embed customer/date/result blocks

## NOTES FOR OPENLIS DESIGN

### Vector LHU Sections (1 report template):
- Header, report number, approval date
- Sampling section: location, date, officers, method (PCR/morphology)
- Result table: sample barcode | type | species ID | [optional: stadium, count, indices]
- Footer: verifier, validator, e-signature

### Environmental LHU Sections (1 report template):
- Header, report number, approval date, accreditation status
- Sample info block: type, origin, location, collector, receipt/test dates, method
- Result table: Parameter | Result | Baku Mutu (threshold) | Unit | Test Method | KAN accreditation flag
- Footer: verifier, validator, e-signature, Halaman X dari Y

### Key OpenELIS Features to Support:
1. **Report number generation:** Context-aware codes (K-AM, B-UR, KP-Makan format)
2. **Multi-report bundling:** Cover letter + multiple detailed LHU sheets (see KL.457, KL.597)
3. **Accreditation flagging:** Per-parameter KAN accreditation indicator
4. **Signature blocks:** Both e-signature (BSSN cert) and placeholder support
5. **Page numbering:** "Halaman X dari Y" footer standard
6. **Standard reference tracking:** SNI code, Permenkes/Permen LHK citation per parameter
7. **Dynamic Baku Mutu:** Contextual threshold values (drinking water vs. wastewater vs. hospital air)
8. **Multi-language support:** Indonesian primary, English parallel common for international headers
